text: iJO1366, one of the most widely used genome-scale metabolic models, reconstructs the metabolism of which organism?
explanation: iJO1366 is a genome-scale reconstruction of Escherichia coli K-12 with 1366 genes and 2583 reactions, making it the most studied bacterial GEM. Saccharomyces cerevisiae is instead represented by the yeast8 consensus reconstruction, human metabolism by Recon3D, and gut-microbiome communities by the AGORA2 collection of models.
